challenge.results: The input/remainder order follows directly from x = uy. The authors allow extra parameters in practical analyzers to carry information, consistent with a binary relation at the level of the grammar model. The paper describes Q-systems separately and places the metamorphosis-grammar compiler in later work. The inspected passages yielded no material contrary evidence within the early grammar model scope.

limitations: Applicability covers the grammar relation and list encoding in the early Marseille analyzer. The model leaves room for additional information-carrying parameters in actual analyzers. Later grammar-rule syntax and implementations lie outside this historical scope.
